name: Minh
text: I told them my height and where I ride and they set the Stance up before I collected it. First weekend on broken road it felt twice as calm as my old hardtail.

name: Lan
text: Finally a frame that fits me. The fitting took an hour and they changed the bar and saddle without charging me.

name: Huy
text: My first mountain bike. They called the same afternoon to check the size and delivered it built and adjusted.

name: Thảo
text: The battery does a long climb and back with charge left. Delivery took four days to my province, a day more than promised.

name: Quân
text: Test-rode three bikes on their loop before choosing the Trance. No pressure, honest advice about which one I actually needed.

name: Hà
text: They set the suspension for my weight and showed me how to check it. The first free service after six weeks was quick.

name: Tuấn
text: Ordered by message, paid by transfer, the bike arrived boxed and almost built. A video call talked me through the last steps.

name: Phúc
text: Good bike for the money. I would have liked the air fork, but they were honest that I did not need it yet.

name: Trang
text: I came in for a tune-up and left knowing exactly what to replace next season. Kind, quick and fairly priced.

name: Khánh
text: Answered my questions at ten at night and had the bike ready the next morning. The 1×10 is so much simpler than my old triple.

name: Dũng
text: Bought it for my wife after she tried it on the test loop. Now she waits for me at the top.

name: Yến
text: Great bike and fair price. The size I wanted was gone, so they ordered it in and kept me posted every week.
